name: test-guard
description: Machine-wide bun test concurrency and memory guard (SC-00062): the flock-semaphore wrapper, the sentinel that watches it, and the regression battery. Shell scripts shipped with the `test-guard` CLI bin; the guard-home reads/writes resolve through the @hasna/paths resolver with a legacy ~/.hasna/test-guard fallback. The package provisions no remote infrastructure and exposes no HTTP, MCP, or importable Node SDK surface.

serviceSurfaces.name: test-guard-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: Bash-only guard: the shipped surface is the sentinel/bun-wrapper/battery shell scripts; there is no importable Node SDK export.

waivedSurfaces.reason: The guard runs host-local (flock semaphore plus systemd-run user scopes) and owns no HTTP service boundary.
The guard is installed as the bun wrapper and sentinel on the host; there is no MCP server bin or tools surface.
